title: Set up harness agent calls
subtitle: Configure MCP or A2A, sign in, then grant access so users can get answers.

steps.title: Add MCP or A2A to the agent
steps.evidence: Add it as a Model Context Protocol tool with Manual OAuth, the delegated permission MCS.InvokeAsMCP, a client secret and a redirect URI.

steps.title: Set app permission and app details
steps.evidence: The setup needs an app registration with the delegated permission MCS.InvokeAsMCP or MCS.InvokeAsA2A, a client secret, a redirect URI and Manual OAuth.

steps.title: Sign in with on-behalf-of consent
steps.evidence: On-behalf-of sign-in lets users consent once in the conversation

steps.title: Share and assign security role
steps.evidence: Share the custom connector with Can view, share the called agent with the user, and assign a security role such as Basic User in a non-default environment.
